children.text: Localways runs small-group food and neighborhood walks led by people who live in the city. Every walk is designed by its guide around the markets, kitchens and streets they know best.
We keep groups small, pay the family businesses we visit fairly and always plan vegetarian options. Send us a booking request and a local will reply personally, usually within 24 hours.

inclusions.text: A glass of local wine or soft drink

data.title: Palermo Street Food Walk
data.subtitle: Markets, traditions and local flavors
data.intro: A morning in Palermo’s oldest market streets, tasting arancine, panelle and sfincione where locals have bought them for generations.
data.summary: Wander the stalls of Ballarò with a local, tasting Palermo’s street food classics and meeting the vendors who make them.

data.title: Sofia
data.headline: Hi, I’m Sofia.
data.intro: I’m a local food lover and storyteller, and I can’t wait to show you my city — its flavors, hidden corners and the people that make it so special.
data.story_title: A city, a family and a passion for good food.
data.story:
I grew up in this neighborhood, where food has always been the heart of our community. My grandmother taught me the recipes, the markets taught me curiosity, and the locals taught me the stories.

Today, I love sharing all of this with travelers from around the world — one bite and one conversation at a time.
data.languages: I speak English, Italian and Spanish.
data.loves: Local markets, family-run trattorias, and hidden neighborhood gems.
data.approach: Small groups, real encounters and authentic experiences beyond the usual sights.
